toolsAdded.description: Preview one bounded atomic group of authorized numeric literal edits. First discover functions and inspect the gateway-provided typed target paths. A target uses its discovered function_handle plus either a control_path and expression_path for an IF comparison operand, or a discovered statement_handle and explicit expression_path (use [] for the assignment RHS root). Include expected_value preconditions. Preview never changes committed BASIC; commit only an accepted transaction. The host-owned mission contract enforces edit count, scope, values and invariants.

toolsAdded.description: Commit an accepted gateway preview by its transaction ID. Commit rechecks the mission and revision atomically.

toolsAdded.name: workspace_validate_mission
toolsAdded.description: Run the independent MIR interpreter/JIT oracle and fresh-workspace replay checks at an explicit revision.
